summary: The customer is extremely angry because their express delivery package is three days late and a previous agent's promise that it would arrive this morning was not met, causing the customer to waste a day off. The agent apologizes, investigates the system to find a driver issue, escalates the issue with an urgent delivery note for today before 5 PM, and offers a compensation voucher which the customer rejects. The call ends with the agent promising to personally monitor the request until delivery.
